suppress.notes: FALSE POSITIVE: CVE-2023-0440 affects healthchecks.io (https://github.com/healthchecks/healthchecks), not Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks. The NuGet package is a Microsoft .NET library; it shares no code with the Django web app. Suppressed pending NVD CPE correction.

FALSE POSITIVE: CVE-2026-39882 is a PATH hijacking vulnerability in OpenTelemetry-Go (kenv command, BSD/Solaris only), fixed in Go module v1.43.0. OpenTelemetry.Api is the .NET NuGet package; it contains no Go code and is not affected.

FALSE POSITIVE: CVE-2026-39883 is a memory-exhaustion vulnerability in the OpenTelemetry-Go OTLP HTTP exporters (unbounded response buffer), fixed in Go module v1.43.0. OpenTelemetry.Api is the .NET NuGet package; it contains no Go code and is not affected.
